newsitem.title: USA: MOTOR RACING-BLUNDELL STABLE AFTER CRASH.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-BLUNDELL STABLE AFTER CRASH.

text.p: British race driver Mark Blundell was listed in stable condition on Saturday morning at a Miami hospital where he was taken by helicopter after his car slammed into a wall during a practice run.
Blundell's Indy-car teammate, Mauricio Gugelmin, told reporters the 31-year-old English driver was "awake, alert and joking" before he was taken on Friday to Miami's Jackson Memorial Hospital.

Blundell crashed heavily when he entered a turn and shattered the right rear of his Indy-car on concrete during spring training for the Championship Auto Racing Teams at the Metro-Dade Homestead Motorsports Complex.
He reported pain in his lower back and neck. It was not known when Blundell might be released from the hospital.
No other cars were involved and no one else was injured.
